description: Authorizes a tool call an AI model asks for, only with a signed approval from a trusted person for that tool (the Intent's target). The tool, resource, environment and risk signals come from the caller, so they can only refuse a call, never authorize one on their own.

unboundSignalReasons.toolAllowed: Declared by the caller. It can refuse a call, never authorize one on its own; only the signed approval behind humanApproval authorizes a call.
unboundSignalReasons.resourceAuthorized: Declared by the caller. It can refuse a call, never authorize one on its own.
unboundSignalReasons.executionEnvironment: A property of the environment the call runs in, declared by the caller. It can refuse a call, never authorize one on its own.
unboundSignalReasons.riskScore: A score the caller computes. It can refuse a call, never authorize one on its own.

outcome.reason: Tool execution rejected because the assessed operational risk exceeds the maximum permitted threshold.
Tool execution rejected because the requested tool is not authorized.
Tool execution rejected because the requested resource is not authorized.
Tool execution rejected because the execution environment is not authorized.
Tool execution authorized with a verified human approval for this tool.
Tool execution rejected. A tool call needs a signed human approval for this tool in signals.approvalArtifact, with humanApproval true, and every other policy condition satisfied.
